domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用于修正线性轮轨蠕滑力结果的非线性接触模型。
usage_note: 文中先采用Kalker线性蠕滑理论，再进行该非线性修正。
usage_overview: 用于车辆—轨道相互作用计算，在Kalker线性蠕滑理论计算的基础上，对轮轨蠕滑力进行受摩擦约束的非线性修正，使蠕滑力计算体现摩擦限制。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: The wheel-rail interaction forces mainly include wheel– rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by the use of Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified by the Shen-Hedrick-Elkins nonlinear model (Shen et al. 1983).
